ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure, the left side of the circuit is a transmission line with characteristic impedance Z0 = 60 Ω. On the right side is connected a lossless transmission line labeled Z0 = 30√2 Ω and length λ/4, whose terminal load is labeled ZL = 30 Ω. In the upper conductor in the figure, a short-circuited line segment labeled Z0 = 30 Ω and length λ/8 is also inserted, with the top labeled Short; according to the method stated in the problem, it is treated as a short-circuited transmission line segment connected in series in the upper conductor. Reasoning: First transform the 30 Ω load through the λ/4, Z0 = 30√2 Ω line segment to its input end. The input impedance of a quarter-wavelength line is Zin = Z0^2 / ZL = (30√2)^2 / 30 = 1800 / 30 = 60 Ω. Then calculate the input impedance of the short-circuited λ/8, Z0 = 30 Ω line segment: Zshort = j Z0 tan(βl), where βl = 2π/λ · λ/8 = π/4, so Zshort = j30 tan(π/4) = j30 Ω. Since this short-circuited line segment is treated as a series element according to the diagram, the equivalent load seen by the 60 Ω line is Zeq = 60 + j30 Ω. Relative to the 60 Ω main line, the reflection coefficient Γ = (Zeq - 60)/(Zeq + 60) = j30/(120 + j30). Its magnitude |Γ| = 30 / sqrt(120^2 + 30^2) ≈ 0.2425. VSWR = (1 + |Γ|)/(1 - |Γ|) ≈ (1.2425)/(0.7575) ≈ 1.64.

method.method_draft: First transform the 30 Ω load through the λ/4, Z0 = 30√2 Ω line: Zin = (30√2)^2/30 = 60 Ω. Since the diagram shows this shorted section as a series element in the upper conductor, the equivalent load seen by the 60 Ω line is Zeq = 60 + j30 Ω. 图像描述：附图中的电路左侧是一段特性阻抗 Z0 = 60 Ω 的传输线。右侧接有一段标注为 Z0 = 30√2 Ω、长度为 λ/4 的无损传输线，其末端负载标注为 ZL = 30 Ω。图中上导体处还插入了一段标注为 Z0 = 30 Ω、长度为 λ/8 的短路线段，顶部标注 Short，按题设方法将它视为串联在上导体中的短路传输线段。

推理：先把 30 Ω 负载通过 λ/4、Z0 = 30√2 Ω 的线段变换到其输入端。四分之一波长线的输入阻抗为 Zin = Z0^2 / ZL = (30√2)^2 / 30 = 1800 / 30 = 60 Ω。再计算短路的 λ/8、Z0 = 30 Ω 线段的输入阻抗：Zshort = j Z0 tan(βl)，其中 βl = 2π/λ · λ/8 = π/4，所以 Zshort = j30 tan(π/4) = j30 Ω。由于该短路线段按图示作为串联元件处理，60 Ω 线看到的等效负载为 Zeq = 60 + j30 Ω。相对于 60 Ω 主线，反射系数 Γ = (Zeq - 60)/(Zeq + 60) = j30/(120 + j30)。其幅值 |Γ| = 30 / sqrt(120^2 + 30^2) ≈ 0.2425。VSWR = (1 + |Γ|)/(1 - |Γ|) ≈ (1.2425)/(0.7575) ≈ 1.64。
